resume: Generative ambient and drone firmware: Immaculate Permutation draws an arrangement in one key, with a pad, a sequence and a chord arpeggio under a fourth voice for your hands. Press PLAY to begin.

commandes.role: On ordinary play pages, transposes the keyboard, arpeggio and sequence of the chosen track. Held: undoes the last rite.
Transposes like OCT-. In Immaculate Permutation, used for Reveal, to reveal another arrangement.
ENV + OCT+: gentle evolution of the harmony.
LFO + OCT+: gentle modulation of the four tracks.
Held 1.2 seconds: checkpoint ("sermon"). Wait for SESSION SAVED, then load the project named A to D.
Starts the starting project, Evening Vow.

gestes: SAVE held 1.2 s: saves a sermon (checkpoint).
OCT- held: undoes the last rite.
ENV + OCT+: evolves the harmony. LFO + OCT+: modulates the four tracks.
a_savoir: Experimental version 0.2.3: save your work before installing.
Saves from this firmware cannot be read by older Felucca or Jangada.
